target.title: fix(ui): preserve sidebar collapsed state when group rename/delete fails
target.body:
Closes #105974

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users renaming or deleting a custom session group from the Control UI sidebar would still lose or rewrite that group's collapsed preference when the Gateway rejected the operation. The group remained on the server, but the sidebar treated the mutation as if it had succeeded and corrupted locally persisted navigation state.

## Why This Change Was Made

Collapsed-section cleanup for group rename/delete ran in `Promise.finally`, so it always ran after both success and rejection. The handlers now update collapsed keys only on successful Gateway completion and leave local storage unchanged when the RPC rejects. No new config, no migration, and no change to successful rename/delete behavior.

Fix quality: compatibility — browser preference follows confirmed Gateway mutations only; performance — same one-shot local storage write on success; usability — failed group edits no longer expand groups unexpectedly after reload; security — no trust-boundary change.

## User Impact

After a failed group rename or delete (network error, permission, or other Gateway rejection), the sidebar keeps the existing collapsed/expanded preference for that group. Successful rename still remaps the collapsed key; successful delete still removes it.

## Evidence

Verification host: local macOS (Crabbox bypass)

Focused regression (reject + success for rename and delete):

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts -t "group mutation collapsed"
✓ keeps collapsed keys when group rename is rejected
✓ rewrites collapsed keys only after group rename succeeds
✓ keeps collapsed keys when group delete is rejected
✓ drops collapsed keys only after group delete succeeds
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  4 passed | 38 skipped (42)
```

Full sibling surface:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts
✓ 42 passed
```

Static: `git diff --check` clean; `pnpm exec oxfmt --check` on touched files clean. `pnpm check:changed` was started but did not produce output within several minutes (local stall); path-scoped static + focused Vitest used as quality-preserving substitute per contributor fix closeout contract.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: rejected `sessions.groups.rename` / `sessions.groups.delete` no longer rewrite `openclaw:sidebar:sessions:collapsed-sections` keys for the affected group.
- Environment: local macOS, openclaw checkout at commit `ed913230c`, Vitest jsdom Control UI harness (`openclaw-app-sidebar`).
- Current-main contrast: on main, both handlers used `.finally()`, so a rejected rename still moved `category:<old>` → `category:<new>` and a rejected delete still removed `category:<group>` from local storage even though the Gateway group remained.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:
  1. Seed localStorage collapsed set to `["category:Alpha"]`.
  2. Mount sidebar with custom group `Alpha`, `connected=true`.
  3. Open group menu → Rename to `Beta` with `groupsRename` rejecting; assert storage still `["category:Alpha"]`.
  4. Same path with rename resolving; assert storage becomes `["category:Beta"]`.
  5. Open group menu → Delete with `groupsDelete` rejecting; assert storage still `["category:Alpha"]`.
  6. Same path with delete resolving; assert storage `[]`.
  Command: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/app-sidebar.test.ts -t "group mutation collapsed"`
- Evidence after fix: all four cases passed (see Evidence terminal output). Reject paths leave the stored JSON byte-for-byte as `["category:Alpha"]`; success paths apply the expected key rewrite/removal only.
- Control check: only the group rename/delete collapsed-key paths changed; success cases still migrate/remove keys; sibling AppSidebar suite (42 tests) still passes.
- Observed result after fix: rejected group mutations no longer corrupt persisted collapsed-section preferences.
- What was not tested: live browser against a real Gateway that rejects group RPCs; full `pnpm check:changed` (stalled locally; substituted path-scoped format + focused tests).

## AI disclosure

This fix was authored with AI assistance (Grok). Human operator ran the automated find→fix→PR pipeline in auto mode; proof is the focused Vitest transcript above.
